description:
Java Front End:
 • 14+ years of total IT experience with special focus on architecture, design, and development of Multi-channel eCommerce and J2EE applications
 • Writing most of the complex code/foundation of the site/app
 • Responsible for initial project setup
 • Provides oversight to other developers, internal and external.
 • Responds to questions from clients and educates them on our process as necessary
 • Involved in Blueprint meetings/project kickoffs
 • Helps define baseline estimates on all project levels.
 • Reviews project requirements and client requests and adapts Front End workflow to accommodate.
 • Pushes back when client requests may be detrimental to development.
 • Provides recommendations and alternate solutions.
 • Provides alternate solutions and consults with Technical Architect on implementation plan 
 
 Java Back End: 
 • Over all 10+ Years where 3Yrs-6Yrs JAVA Extensive Experience
 • Spring 3.0 Extensive Experience
 • Soap and Rest Services Extensive Experience
 • Jaxb Hands on
 • Spring Dynamic Modules(OSGI) Extensive Experience
 • Oracle 10 Hands on
 • Hibernate Extensive Experience 
 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
